description: Create an Airflow module for energy_grid that generates the same meter-readings pipeline for three regions (north, central, south), each with its own timezone and schedule, from a Python dictionary of region settings. Each generated DAG 'meter_readings_<region>' must: (1) run at 01:00 local time of its region, (2) extract the previous local calendar day of readings, (3) aggregate to 15-minute intervals, (4) load to a region-partitioned table. The generator must use a function that returns a DAG built with the @dag decorator and must pass region settings via params so they are visible in the UI.

expected_behavior.local_day_window: [local midnight, next local midnight) converted to UTC

edge_cases: On DST transition days the local day has 23 or 25 hours; the UTC window must be computed from local midnights, not as a fixed 24-hour offset
Each DAG's start_date must carry the region's timezone so the cron is evaluated in local time
The @dag-decorated function must be called and its result assigned to a unique module-level name for each region
15-minute bucketing on the autumn DST day yields 100 intervals; bucketing must be done in UTC and labelled with local time plus offset
common_failure_modes: FM2: Extract window computed as UTC midnight to midnight shifts every region's day by 1-3 hours
FM6: Generated DAGs overwrite each other because they are assigned to the same variable name
FM3: Bucketing by local wall-clock time merges the repeated hour on the autumn DST day
